scope: Recomputable parity evidence over the canonical C0 public read-only method set and the current offline MCP tool and A2A skill mappings. No transport, wire conformance, live authorization, runtime authority parity or execution path is verified or created.
core_invariant: Protocol-shaped discovery metadata may map to the same canonical C0 public read-only methods, but mapping equivalence is not protocol conformance, transport availability, permission or runtime authority parity.

risks: multiple external ids alias one canonical method while another disappears
controls: exact one-to-one coverage of the supplied canonical C0 method set
mapping digests bind exact external-id-to-C0 relations

risks: Agent Card skill treated as capability grant
offline shape marketed as MCP compatibility
offline Agent Card candidate marketed as A2A conformance
mapping parity represented as transport verification
content-addressed report treated as authenticated third-party assurance
report mutated and rehashed after mapping substitution
controls: inner C0/MCP/A2A mapping digests are rechecked independently of the outer report digest
current Stage C exports are supplied by the caller/test

known_nonclaims: This parity laboratory does not authenticate the supplied source exports.
This parity laboratory does not prove MCP or A2A wire-protocol conformance.
This parity laboratory does not prove a network or stdio transport exists.
This parity laboratory does not perform live authorization or compare runtime authority decisions.
This parity laboratory does not make the offline A2A candidate servable or conformant.
This parity laboratory grants no runtime, repository, merge, deployment or protocol-activation authority.
This parity laboratory does not modify capability-registry or production state.
next_gates: bind source-export provenance if a portable parity artifact is ever required
test a real read-only MCP transport only after separate transport/security review
test a real A2A interface only after an interface exists and conformance is independently established
keep Agent Trust A2 requestability parity separate from public discovery mapping parity
preserve remote-result provenance without treating remote claims as verified local facts
